·Tips (1):
Cabaret
·Tips (1)
· If you order a Yamazaki 12-year-old whisky, you will automatically
keep the bottle.
Until the bottle's all finished, your drinks will refill automatically,
so you can skip having to order each time.
· If you order a Gacha Drink, you get a shot at a capsule vending
machine, which will award you an item.
You can get items that give discounts on the club's prices, or
valuable items that you can use in battle.
If you have the money to spare, it may be worth a try.
· Tips (2):
Cabaret
· Tips (2)
·. When you bring up gossip you've heard on the street,
that is relevant to what you were talking about directly before,
you get a combo bonus, and might liven the conversation up more than usual.
Try some combinations and see what works.
However, in some rare cases, you can bring down a hostess's mood,
so be careful choosing topics.
· When your Heat Gauge fills up, the hostesses will be more
intimate with you than normal.
In these cases, if you order off the exclusive menu, you can trigger special
events that otherwise wouldn't happen.
